headline: Andy Burnham’s Manchester City comments stir fresh tensions with Premier League
body: Government said to be unhappy at lack of warning Treasury committee chair wants HMRC involved in case Andy Burnham’s intervention in the Manchester City debate has revived tensions between the Premier League and the prime minister. Government officials are understood to be unhappy they were not given notice that the independent commission’s damning judgment of £900m of financial manipulation and “sham contracts” would be published shortly after Burnham’s address at the Labour party conference on Tuesday, and his response has not gone down well with several Premier League clubs concerned by his relationship with City’s owners.
